Generic.Label: Generic d20 (configured paths)
Generic.MenuHint: For game systems without a FastFighting helper module: where to find HP, AC, attack bonus and damage on actors.
Generic.Hint: Property paths on the actor, e.g. system.attributes.hp.value. Leave attack or damage empty to estimate them from level.

runs.Name: Simulations per estimate
runs.Hint: How many battles to simulate. More is steadier but slower; 2000 takes well under a second for a typical fight.

maxRounds.Name: Maximum rounds
maxRounds.Hint: A simulated battle still going after this many rounds counts as a stalemate.

includeHidden.Name: Include hidden tokens
includeHidden.Hint: Hidden tokens (ambushers, reinforcements) take part in estimates by default.

includeOtherLevels.Name: Include other scene levels
includeOtherLevels.Hint: Include tokens on scene Levels other than the one being viewed.

neutralDefault.Name: Neutral tokens
neutralDefault.Hint: Default handling of tokens with Neutral disposition. Can be changed per battle and per token.

secretDefault.Name: Secret tokens
secretDefault.Hint: Default handling of tokens with Secret disposition.

downedModel.Name: Downed characters
downedModel.Hint: How falling to 0 HP is simulated. 'Simulate dying and healing' follows the system's rules for dying, recovery and revival.

pcHealAggro.Name: Default PC healing
pcHealAggro.Hint: How freely player characters spend spells, potions and actions on healing, unless set per character in the Battle Planner.

pcAllyDying.Name: Default PC response to a dying ally
pcAllyDying.Hint: What player characters prioritize when an ally is dying, unless set per character.

leadership.Name: Leadership
leadership.Hint: Leaders (best social or warfare skill, Commanders, rallying abilities) raise their side's bravery and coordination while standing.

morale.Name: Morale and routing
morale.Hint: Combatants may waver or flee based on bravery, wounds, losses and a fallen leader or master.

positioning.Name: Positioning and terrain
positioning.Hint: Use token distances, movement types, terrain costs, walls and elevation. Turn off for theater-of-the-mind scenes.

surpriseDefault.Name: Initiative
surpriseDefault.Hint: Use the combat tracker's initiative when present, roll Stealth for hidden or Secret tokens, or roll normally.

reportAccuracy.Name: Player report accuracy
reportAccuracy.Hint: How precisely the player chat card describes the odds, from exact statistics to pure flavor.

reportMode.Name: Player report delivery
reportMode.Hint: Post player reports publicly or whisper them to the players.

reportHideEnemyNames.Name: Hide enemy names in reports
reportHideEnemyNames.Hint: Refer to enemies generically in player reports.

lootMode.Name: Make it So: loot
lootMode.Hint: What happens to a slain creature's gear: leave it on the corpse (lootable), drop it in a loot pile, or do nothing.

corpseMode.Name: Make it So: corpses
corpseMode.Hint: Keep slain tokens on the map with the dead marker, or remove them (when a loot pile is dropped).

fledMode.Name: Make it So: fled combatants
fledMode.Hint: Hide tokens that fled the battle, or leave them where they are.

sideDefaults.Name: Side personality defaults
sideDefaults.Label: Configure
sideDefaults.Hint: Default group Tactical, Brave, Selfish and Loyal values for Friendly, Hostile, Neutral and Secret sides.

talking.Name: Talking
talking.Hint: Characters may try to de-escalate: talk enemies who share a language into surrendering, fleeing, or (rarely, unless neutral) switching sides.

Hint.tactician: Qualitative odds, the most dangerous foe, and how long it should take.
Hint.storyteller: In-world phrasing that still makes the danger obvious.

Defaults.Hint: Group personality for each side. Every member's own values are blended with these, and both can be fudged per battle.

Planner.Title: Battle Planner
Planner.PositioningHint: Distances, movement types, terrain cost, walls and elevation
Planner.RefreshHint: Re-read the tokens on the scene
Planner.Disposition: Tactics (ask your player, or use Prepare Players)
Planner.NoAdapter: FastFighting has no support for this game system yet. A helper module can add it.
Planner.TalkingHint: Let characters talk foes down mid-fight (Diplomacy, Intimidation, Deception)

Results.Stale: Settings changed since this run. Run again to update.
Results.EmptyBody: Every token on the scene is listed on the left by side. Adjust personalities, allegiances and dispositions, then run thousands of simulated fights.

Swing.Hint: Re-runs the battle without each combatant and modifier to show what moves the party's odds most.

Sample.NotFound: No simulated fight matched that outcome. It may be very unlikely.

MakeItSo.Title: Make it So
MakeItSo.Confirm: Commit this fight's outcome to the tokens? The following changes will be made:
MakeItSo.UndoHint: You can undo this from the Sample fight tab.
MakeItSo.Failed: Make it So could not update {name}. See the console for details.
MakeItSo.Done: The outcome has been committed to the tokens.
MakeItSo.UndoConfirm: Restore the tokens to how they were before the last Make it So on this scene?
MakeItSo.SurrenderedHint: Laid down arms during a FastFighting battle and is at the victors' mercy.

Stat.Death: Chance at least one PC dies: {death}. Chance someone is knocked down: {downed}.
Stat.Talk: Chance at least one foe is talked down: {p}.

Analyst.Death: About 1 in {n} of these fights kills someone.
Analyst.Talk: About {p} of the time, someone can be talked out of fighting.

Length.brief: It should be over almost at once.

Tactician.Talk: Words may win part of this fight.

Odds.overwhelming: This should be well in hand.
Odds.favorable: The odds are with you, but blood will be spilled.
Odds.unfavorable: Every instinct says this is a fight you could lose.
Odds.dire: Steel yourselves: this is a fight you are likely to lose.

Death.high: Someone may not walk away from this.
Death.real: Someone could fall and not rise again.
Death.low: It will hurt, but you should all live through it.

Length.brief: It will be over in moments.
Length.short: It will be quick and brutal.
Length.long: It will be a long, hard struggle.
Length.grinding: It will grind on until someone breaks.

Story.Talk: Not every foe here seems eager to die for this.

Roleplayer.overwhelming: Your foes look small and uncertain before you.
Roleplayer.favorable: The air is tense, but your footing feels sure.
Roleplayer.even: The moment hangs balanced on a blade's edge.
Roleplayer.unfavorable: A cold weight settles in your stomach.
Roleplayer.dire: Somewhere nearby, carrion birds have begun to gather.

preferredAction.Label: Favorite weapon or attack
preferredAction.Hint: The attack this character reaches for first. They still switch when something else is clearly better.

style.Label: Fighting style
style.Hint: How this character likes to fight.
style.frontline: Front line: close in and hold the line
style.skirmisher: Skirmisher: flank, strike twice, keep moving
style.ranged: Ranged: keep my distance and shoot
style.protector: Protector: guard my allies, shield up

target.Label: Who to attack first
target.Hint: Target priority when there is a choice.

resourceUse.Label: Spell slots, focus and limited abilities
resourceUse.Hint: How readily this character spends resources that only come back after rest.
resourceUse.balanced: Use them when they are clearly better
resourceUse.nova: Spend freely to end it fast

healAggro.Label: Healing others
healAggro.Hint: How freely this character spends actions and resources healing allies.
healAggro.conservative: Only when someone is dying or badly hurt
healAggro.allCosts: Heal at all costs, even with my last resources

potionThreshold.25: Below a quarter of my HP
potionThreshold.Label: Drinking my own potions
potionThreshold.Hint: When this character drinks healing potions or elixirs.

allyDying.Label: When an ally is dying
allyDying.Hint: What this character does the moment a friend goes down.

selfRevived.Label: After I'm revived
selfRevived.Hint: What this character does after getting back up.

retreat.Label: When to retreat
retreat.Hint: When this character would leave the battle.
retreat.losing: When the battle turns against us

shield.Label: Shield
shield.Hint: How this character uses Raise a Shield.

notes.Label: Anything else the GM should know
notes.Hint: For example: protect Ezren at all costs; won't harm the dog.

talk.Label: Talking instead of fighting
talk.Hint: Whether this character tries to end fights with words: persuading, threatening or bluffing foes who share a language into surrendering, fleeing or switching sides. It takes several successes to convince most foes, and anyone this character has hurt or failed to convince is much harder to sway.
talk.first: Talk first: try to end it with words
talk.never: Let my weapons do the talking

Survey.Title: Prepare for Battle
Survey.Intro: Your GM wants to know how your characters fight in {scene}. Answers save as you go, and anyone sharing a character sees changes live.
Survey.NoTokens: You don't control any tokens on this battle map.
Survey.ResetHint: Return every answer for this character to "let them decide".
Survey.AutoHint: "Let … decide" is what your character would probably do. Change anything you'd do differently.
Survey.Thanks: Thanks! Your GM can see you're ready.
Survey.PrepareHint: Open a tactics survey on every player's screen for the tokens they control on this map.
Survey.NoPlayers: No players control tokens on this scene.
Survey.NoPlayersHere: No players control tokens on this scene. Fill in tactics yourself in each PC's row.
Survey.WillOpen: {name} is offline; their survey will open when they log in.

Playstyle.Label: Playstyles
Playstyle.Hint: Pick up to four labels that describe how this character really plays. They change what "Let them decide" means and how the simulation predicts them. The first one picked wins when two disagree.
Playstyle.Max: Pick at most four playstyles. Unpick one first.
Playstyle.StayTrue: Stay mostly true to my calculated tactical level
Playstyle.StayTrueHint: Your answers and playstyles can only move the calculated strategy by about 10%: trait shifts are capped at ±10, and any choice that differs from the calculation shows up in only about 1 in 10 simulated fights.
Playstyle.Roleplay: Roleplaying is very important to me
Playstyle.RoleplayHint: The simulation weighs your playstyles heavily: their personality shifts double and their quirks (finishing foes, parleying, studying enemies…) happen much more often.
Playstyle.Both: Both boxes are checked: roleplay strengthens your playstyles, but staying true still caps how far they move you from the calculated strategy.

scaredyCat.Name: Scaredy-Cat
scaredyCat.Hint: Much less brave, hangs back, drinks potions early, retreats when hurt, and tends to go unnoticed.

cruel.Name: Cruel
cruel.Hint: Picks on the weakest and finishes off the fallen.

moralist.Name: Moralist
moralist.Hint: Never strikes a fallen foe; rushes to save allies.

peoplePleaser.Name: People-Pleaser
peoplePleaser.Hint: Goes along with the group: attacks what allies attack, heals generously, protects friends.

fragile.Name: Fragile
fragile.Hint: Less brave; drinks potions early, retreats when hurt, heals self after being revived.

impatient.Name: Impatient
impatient.Hint: Charges the nearest foe, spends resources freely, skips the shield.

brawler.Name: Brawler
brawler.Hint: Loves melee: front line, nearest foe, braver.

skeptic.Name: Skeptic
skeptic.Hint: Careful and calculating: saves resources, heals sparingly, a little more tactical.

speedRunner.Name: Speed-Runner
speedRunner.Hint: Wants it over fast: spends everything, goes for quick kills.

leader.Name: Leader
leader.Hint: Steps up to lead the side, braver and more loyal, goes for the biggest threat.

instigator.Name: Instigator
instigator.Hint: Acts first, picks fights with the most dangerous foe, and draws attacks.

diplomat.Name: Diplomat
diplomat.Hint: Opens by trying to talk, often spares the fallen, less selfish.

wallflower.Name: Wallflower
wallflower.Hint: Stays at range and out of notice; enemies often overlook them.

martyr.Name: Martyr
martyr.Hint: Never retreats, heals at all costs, guards allies, and throws themselves into danger.

mercenary.Name: Mercenary
mercenary.Hint: Looks out for number one: conserves resources, keeps fighting over rescuing, retreats when it turns.

enabler.Name: Enabler
enabler.Hint: Support first: heals and protects allies, follows the group's lead.

redeemSeeker.Name: Redeem-Seeker
redeemSeeker.Hint: Braver and selfless, fights on the front line to save others, never retreats.

loreCollector.Name: Lore-Collector
loreCollector.Hint: Studies a new foe before fighting it (Recall Knowledge), then fights it better.

puzzleManiac.Name: Puzzle-Maniac
puzzleManiac.Hint: Much more tactical; exploits weaknesses and goes after casters.

wildcard.Name: Wildcard
wildcard.Hint: Unpredictable: sometimes attacks someone random or does something unexpected.
